children: On August 31, 2026, the company received a Nasdaq notice that it no longer meets Nasdaq Listing Rule 5550(b)(1) requiring at least $2.5 million in stockholders' equity, reporting $1,782,000 as of June 30, 2026. There is no immediate impact on trading; the company has until October 15, 2026 to submit a compliance plan and may receive up to February 27, 2027 to regain compliance.
